scenes.text: The sandwich is named after a real British earl who reportedly wouldn't leave a card game.
He was John Montagu, the fourth Earl of Sandwich, in the seventeen hundreds.
A French travel book claimed he once spent twenty-four hours at a gambling table.
To keep playing, he asked for beef between two slices of toasted bread.
Historians think it may be a legend, and he might have just eaten them at his desk.
Captain Cook even named Hawaii the Sandwich Islands after him.

title: The sandwich is named after a real person 🥪
caption: John Montagu, the 4th Earl of Sandwich, supposedly ate beef between bread so he didn't have to leave a card game, though historians think the story may be a legend. Happy National Sandwich Day (Nov 3)! 🥪
